entries.label: 12 Oct 2026
entries.text: The change log starts here — the two-party preferred estimate is 52.3 (Labor v One Nation, implied flows). Primary votes: Labor 27.6, the Coalition 21.8, One Nation 26.3, the Greens 13.4, others 10.9. Leader ratings: Albanese's net approval −21.7, Albanese's net favourability −20.7, Taylor's net approval −6.9, Taylor's net favourability −4.7, Hanson's net approval −2.6, Hanson's net favourability −5.6. National direction: right track 24.0, wrong track 63.9 (net −39.9). Leading significantly as the best party: Labor on climate change; One Nation on crime; the Coalition on economic management; Labor on health; One Nation on immigration. Moving significantly over the past month: the share naming economic management a top-three issue (up); Labor's share as the best party on housing (down). From today, every movement in these figures and every statistical finding that comes or goes is recorded here.
